children: Dell Technologies reported record second-quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $47.0 billion and GAAP diluted EPS of $6.34, driven by strong AI server demand. The company generated $2.2 billion in cash from operations and returned a record $4.3 billion to shareholders in the quarter. Management raised full-year FY27 revenue guidance to $192.0 billion and updated GAAP and non-GAAP EPS targets.
Revenue: Record net revenue of $46,971 million for Q2 FY27, up 58% year over year.
Gross profit and margin: Gross margin of $9,830 million (20.9% of revenue) for the quarter.
Operating income: Operating income of $5,385 million for the quarter, up 204% year over year.
Net income and EPS: Net income of $4,133 million and GAAP diluted earnings per share of $6.34 for the quarter; non-GAAP diluted EPS of $7.04.
Cash flow & returns: Cash flow from operations of $2,225 million for the quarter and adjusted free cash flow of $8,149 million; returned $4.3 billion to shareholders via repurchases and dividends.

AI server momentum: ISG AI-Optimized Servers revenue reached a record $16,401 million for the quarter with a record $95 billion backlog and $60.9 billion in orders booked in the quarter (as disclosed by management).
Infrastructure strength: ISG total net revenue was a record $31,782 million, with Traditional Servers and Networking up 122% and Storage up 26% year over year.
Client demand: Client Solutions Group revenue rose 20% year over year to $15,034 million, including record commercial client revenue of $13,192 million.
Operational profitability: ISG operating income margin expanded to 15.0% of ISG net revenue; ISG operating income was $4,781 million for the quarter.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Dell Technologies posts Q2 FY27 record $47.0B revenue, GAAP EPS $6.34, raises FY27 revenue guide
